blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY — More than 200 aspiring police officers from Bohol are expected to take the Philippine National Police Academy Cadet Admission Test (PNPACAT) on Sunday, Oct. 25, as the province hosts the entrance examination for the first time. The examination will be held at Tagbilaran City College after Gov. Aris Aumentado requested that the test be brought closer to aspiring cadets in Bohol. PLt. Col. Arnel Angeles Peñera, chief examiner of the cadet admission test, said holding the examination in the province would spare applicants the additional expenses and inconvenience of traveling to testing centers outside Bohol.
